about: Illustrations for Le Café des Questions (dialogues 41-60). AI-generated with Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 (Apache-2.0), run on the author's own AWS GPU (one EC2 g7e.2xlarge instance, kit gpu-batch); character designs by the project author. Each episode is an image edit of a cast sheet (the chosen character portraits, painted by the same model on a blank canvas) with the scene prompt. Episodes 1, 3, 5, 11, 14, 15, 18 and 20 were regenerated later with stricter prompts; episode 20 is a multi-image edit (the published episode 16 picture plus the Thomas and Hugo portraits, see refs). Images marked "published": false had no take that passed QA and are not on the site.
provider: self-hosted on the author's own AWS account (Amazon EC2 GPU)
